media.title: Claude operates an iOS Simulator from a terminal environment

title: Put the iOS Simulator Inside the Agent’s Terminal Loop
summary: Landseer Enga demonstrates an iOS Simulator exposed inside a terminal environment, with Claude tapping, editing, and testing an app. The demo targets the environment gap that otherwise leaves terminal-first agents able to edit Swift but unable to observe native behavior.
takeaway: Evaluate simulator tooling with one full acceptance flow: launch, navigate, edit state, capture evidence, and detect a deliberate regression. Do not judge it from build success alone.
